No standing hero beside mount except final defeat pose.
STRICT SHEET: exactly FOUR columns by SEVEN rows, 28 equal cells, every cell occupied by ONE complete mounted character. No dividers or labels. Cell content kept inside its cell with ample transparent padding. All cells same size and scale.

Row 2: gallop D rear legs reaching; attack/cast while seated; hit recoil while seated; peaceful non-graphic defeated rider slumped beside a calm standing steed.
Rows 3 through 7: MAP gallop cycles, FOUR distinct consecutive gallop frames A,B,C,D in each row. Row3 SOUTH/front toward viewer. Row4 SOUTHEAST/front-right diagonal. Row5 EAST/right full profile. Row6 NORTHEAST/back-right diagonal. Row7 NORTH/back away from viewer (show back, no face). Horse and rider turn together. Maintain consistent anatomy, size and costume. No quarter-left orientations.
